tooltip.earth_human.canteen: Reusable water container. Craft with a water bucket or potion to fill it.
tooltip.earth_human.filled_canteen: Reliable exploration hydration. Returns an empty canteen after drinking.
tooltip.earth_human.water_purification_t: Simplified water treatment item. v0.1 gives small hydration directly; water quality comes later.
tooltip.earth_human.oral_rehydration_sal: Basic sugar and electrolyte recovery for dehydration.
tooltip.earth_human.electrolyte_tablet: Restores a little hydration and eases fatigue after sprinting.
tooltip.earth_human.rehydration_drink: Better than plain water for Nether trips and long exploration.
tooltip.earth_human.restorative_tea: Warm drink for rain, water exposure or a short recovery stop.
tooltip.earth_human.energy_bar: Portable calorie support. Mainly reduces fatigue.
tooltip.earth_human.glucose_gel: Fast sugar support. Reduces fatigue quickly.
tooltip.earth_human.cooling_pack: Temporary cooling for high body temperature. It does not replace leaving heat sources.
tooltip.earth_human.heat_pack: Temporary warming for low body temperature. It does not replace shelter.
tooltip.earth_human.emergency_blanket: Emergency warming item for hypothermia risk.
tooltip.earth_human.clean_cloth: Base medical material for bandages, masks and disinfectant supplies.
tooltip.earth_human.simple_bandage: Temporary dressing. v0.1 gives light recovery; wounds come later.
tooltip.earth_human.sterile_bandage: Cleaner dressing with steadier recovery; later reduces infection risk.
tooltip.earth_human.disinfectant_wipe: Medical disinfectant material. v0.1 crafting item; wound and exposure use comes later.
tooltip.earth_human.antiseptic_bottle: Bottle of antiseptic. Used for first aid kits now, wound treatment later.
tooltip.earth_human.basic_first_aid_kit: Basic first aid bundle for testing the first health loop.
tooltip.earth_human.cloth_mask: Basic face covering. Dust, smoke and air quality integration comes later.
tooltip.earth_human.dust_mask: Better dust protection for future mining dust and industrial smoke.
tooltip.earth_human.simple_thermometer: Simple body-temperature tool. Currently a handbook/debug item.
tooltip.earth_human.field_health_note: Field health notebook. Later it becomes the player handbook entry.
message.earth_human.loaded: §a[Earth Human] v0.1.3 loaded: hydration, body temperature, fatigue and supernatural adaptation integration are enabled.
message.earth_human.quick_help: §7Use /earthhuman status for body status, or /earthhuman help for first-version guidance. Craft a Field Health Note for the future handbook entry.
message.earth_human.players_only: This command can only be used by a player.
message.earth_human.status.title: §e=== Earth Human / Body Status ===
message.earth_human.status.arcana: §aSupernatural adaptation: cultivation %s, magic %s, fasting %s, extra air +%s ticks.
message.earth_human.status.hint: §7Water, canteens, rehydration salts and drinks restore hydration; rest, tea and energy food reduce fatigue; heat/cooling packs adjust temperature temporarily.
message.earth_human.help.title: §eEarth Human v0.1.3 first-version guide
message.earth_human.help.status: §7/earthhuman status: show hydration, body temperature and fatigue.
message.earth_human.help.thirst: §7Hydration declines over time. Sprinting and the Nether drain it faster. Carry a filled canteen, rehydration salts or drinks.
message.earth_human.help.fatigue: §7Movement and sprinting build fatigue. Rest, sleep, restorative tea, energy bars and glucose gel recover it. Severe fatigue lightly hurts mining/combat efficiency.
message.earth_human.help.temperature: §7The Nether is hot; rain and water are cold. Heat packs, blankets and cooling packs are temporary tools; leaving the extreme environment is the real fix.
message.earth_human.help.arcana: §7With the Xuanhuan or Magic branches installed, fasting, body tempering, breath training and arcane wards automatically improve hunger pressure, fatigue, temperature stress and underwater breathing.
message.earth_human.reset.done: §aYour Earth Human body status has been reset.
message.earth_human.warning.thirst: §cYou are clearly dehydrated. Drink water, a canteen, rehydration salts or a rehydration drink.
message.earth_human.warning.fatigue: §cYou are very fatigued. Rest, sleep, or use restorative tea / energy food.
message.earth_human.warning.cold: §bYour body temperature is low. Leave water/rain, find warmth, or use a heat pack / blanket.
message.earth_human.warning.heat: §6Your body temperature is high. Avoid hot environments, hydrate, or use a cooling pack.
